Global Communication Semiconductors.why: Compound-semiconductor (InP/GaAs) optoelectronic wafer foundry and own-brand InGaAs PIN photodiode maker whose AOC-brand optoelectronic products (68.72% of 2025 revenue) go into 100G-1.6T data-center optical transceivers; its revenue grows with AI optical-module demand.
Global Communication Semiconductors.evidence: GCS Holdings 2025 Annual Report (04-05-2026), letter to shareholders: own-brand optoelectronic component revenue rose about 44% on AI and data-center demand; it develops 200G photodiodes and transmitter components for data-center customers' 100G to 1.6T transceiver modules, and its PD line achieved a high market share in 2025.

players.product: InP/GaAs optoelectronic wafer foundry (lasers, photodiodes, PIC) and own-brand InGaAs PIN photodiodes (100G-200G per lane) for 800G/1.6T data-center transceivers

quarterly_data.quarter: Global Communication Semiconductors IR presentation: Q2 2026 online investor conference (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 net operating revenue was NT$770,103 thousand (US$24,377 thousand), up 7.8% QoQ and 57.2% YoY; gross margin 43.3% (54.5% in 1Q26, 48.8% in 2Q25); operating margin 12.7%; net profit attributable to owners of the parent NT$110,160 thousand; basic EPS NT$0.92. First-half 2026 revenue was NT$1,484,783 thousand, up 54.2% YoY, with gross margin 48.7% and basic EPS NT$2.58.
